Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

June 10th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that three rebel leaders named
Li Tsung Woo李徵五 Tsung Tsun Ching曾正卿 and Liu
San Tsche刘三扯 are very active at present and are
trying to arrange to have Shanghai declare independence.
It is said that these have about three hundred followers,
to each of whom they pay about thirty cents per day.
They intend to commence operations by murdering Zee
Koh Liang徐国梁 Chief of Police, and Military Governor Yang.
General Yang has received a telegram from Nanking
stating that information has been received by Chiangchun
Feng Kou Chang that Deputy Military Governor Lu of
Woosung intends to oppose the new President. The
telegram adds that Lu is secretly communicating with
General Chang Hsun, who is also opposed to the
new occupant of the presidential chair. It is
rumoured that General Lu's soldiers are making
preparations to resist an attack from the Shanghai side.
Ten boxes of ammunition were sent from the
Arsenal to Nanking on 9th inst by a transport.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

10/6 A.D.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered and June 10.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（刑事科。）

1916年6月10日

先生：
据报，三名名为李徵五、曾正卿和刘三扯的叛军首领目前活动频繁，正试图策划让上海宣布独立。据称，这些人约有三百名追随者，他们向每人每天支付约三十分。他们打算以谋杀警察厅长徐国梁和督军杨来开始行动。

杨将军收到一份来自南京的电报，称将军冯国璋已获悉，吴淞副都统陆意图反对新总统。电报补充说，陆正与张勋将军秘密联络，后者同样反对总统宝座的新占有者。据传，陆将军的士兵正准备抵抗来自上海方面的进攻。

本月9日，十箱弹药由一艘运输船从兵工厂运往南京。

您忠诚的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗 (William Armstrong)
刑事总督察

6月10日 A.D.

警务处长。

已登记，6月10日。
抄送 C.V.C.
